# Chart.js 4.4.1

Vendored for the motion-analysis experiment so its graphs and controls do not depend on a third-party CDN being reachable.

- Upstream: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.4.1
- Unmodified distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md`.
- The original license header is retained in the distribution.
